text_block_list.text:
With the Satsuki Sho quickly approaching,
I've altered Winning
Ticket's training to
have a more concentrated focus on the
race.

I'm thinking over how to improve her
training regimen to help secure
her first
Classics win, when Ticket herself pays a
visit.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey there! Oh, don't mind me. Feel free to
keep working.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Now, it should be with the exhibit stuff...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah... An old notebook...

I'm watching the distracted racer rummage
around, when—
Ring, ring...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Huh? My mentor's calling.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Your mentor? Oh! The one who got the
URA award!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
We haven't spoken since I congratulated
him after the ceremony. I
wonder what's
up... Hello?

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
Hey, kid. Are you well? I hear that new
trainee of yours is stirring up a
storm, so
thought I'd give you a call.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Tickezo... I mean, our new member,
Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
So? You confident she can do it? The
Derby's the top of the top.
Only real
highfliers make it into that race.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Obviously we intend to win. All of Team
Sirius is carrying on your
dream of
conquering the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Right, what I said in my
acceptance speech.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No one can beat her in terms of drive.
She's been dreaming about the
Derby
since she was little.

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
Good, that long-held dream is a strength
that will serve her well in
the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
I'm not trying to sound like an idealist or
anything, but the Derby is
where ability
and emotion collide.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I got the picture pretty clearly
when I saw you talking about it.

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
In the end we didn't win, but all that
experience leading up to it
wasn't for
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
Anyhow, you've got this old man excited
to see her in the Derby.

We talk more about the team and its
members until saying goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOW, that was a surprise. I was wondering
what was up when I heard
my name.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
He said hi and that he wants you to make
a real Derby trainer out of
me.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
He said hi and that he wants you to make
a real Derby trainer out of
me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you got it! So long as you make me
a Derby champion!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait... Is it that I win or that you lead me to win? I'm all confused now.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, I was looking for something! I
used it at the exhibit, so it
should be
around here...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah, here it is! My Derby notebook!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I accidentally left it in this box, I
guess.

She shows me a notebook, which has
childlike scribbles about the
Derby
scrawled all over it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
This is a record of all the Derbies I've seen
and what I thought about
each one. And...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My own path to the Derby is outlined in
here.

Winning Ticket takes out some photo
stickers and puts them in the
notebook.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: There, all done!

The three friendly rivals—Winning Ticket,
Biwa Hayahide, and Narita
Taishin—now
have their precious memories stored in the
notebook.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The next page'll be photos from my win at
the Derby. Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I was a scrawny little kid growing up.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My mom was so worried she had me doing
all sorts of sports. She'd
take me to see
them a lot too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sports train both the body and mind! She
sounds like one tough
mommy, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But, like, the first race I ever saw live was
the Derby. I said it before,
but it really
blew my socks off.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The proud winner, the racers who ran
against all odds and didn't quit
till the
very end, and the countless cheering
fans...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, racing was all I could
think about. I was in tons of
sports classes,
but I told my mom I was quitting them all.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back on it, it was way too
sudden. But mom said "We'll just
have to
go out and buy running shoes!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm suuuper bad at studying, but I really
stuck with racing. You see,
it's because of
the Derby that I got to meet you and all
my friends!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So... It's my mission to race in the Derby
and win it!

It isn't easy to keep running toward a
childhood dream.

But Winning Ticket's still going after hers.
The memory she has of
watching the
Derby that day has never faded.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for going on about the Derby for so
long. I get so carried away
talking about it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You really love it, huh?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You really love it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you bet I do! I'm confident I can't
be beaten when it comes to
passion!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way... I was gonna take this
home, but I'll give it to you
instead.

The bright-eyed enthusiast hands over her
Derby notebook.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's absolutely packed with stuff about the
Derby, so give it a good
read! It'll make
your love for the race even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, see you tomorrow! Can't wait for
another day of training!

After I watch her run off, I take a look at
the notebook she left me.

On the front, written in giant, childlike
scribbles, is "Derby Notes."
Somehow, the
clumsy writing seems to really stress how
strongly she
feels.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that...

It's dark outside. But that doesn't stop
someone from running around
the training
course.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Phew... 'Kay, next I'll do ten sprints.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Taishin... She's still training this late at
night.

As I watch her running in the darkness, I
am reminded of an obvious,
unchanging
truth.

Winning Ticket is not the only one who's
determined to win. The
Derby is a dream
and an honor for all racers.
